extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / editors (people attempting to create or find an article)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for contributors who try to create or locate a Wikipedia article with a given title; covers prerequisites to create pages, alternative submission routes, and checks to perform before creating a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Article existence check
rubrics_metrics.description: Wikipedia does not have an article with this exact name. Search for "Joke Joke" in existing articles. Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, search existing articles and incoming links to avoid duplicate or redundant pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only logged-in, autoconfirmed users can create new articles directly; if you are not yet autoconfirmed, use alternative submission methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard or request new article (alternative submission)
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create a page directly (e.g., not autoconfirmed), submit a draft via the Article Wizard or file a request so experienced editors can review and create the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow for database propagation/delay
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a newly created page but don't see it, allow time for propagation or use the purge function to refresh cached content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title capitalization and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a title, verify capitalization variants and prefer creating redirects when appropriate so readers can find the page under alternate spellings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deleted pages diagnostic
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a page previously existed but is absent now, consult the deletion log and deletion guidance to understand reasons and potential remedies (e.g., notability, sourcing).
